title: Plan for OD-1: the anvil convert MVP
body:
The milestone plan for the convert MVP, covering R1, R2, R4, R5 plus OD-1/R1000 (output precision) and OD-4/R1001 (invocation syntax). Also files BL-6, a LOW uncertainty about non-finite values, proceeding on its recorded default per AGENTS.md.

Opened by the delivery driver on base run/web.
